name: apple-mcp-plus
description: Local macOS MCP tools for Contacts, Notes, Messages, Mail, Reminders and Calendar
long_description: Apple MCP Plus is an independent derivative with tested local queries, native Notes checklist reads and an explicit EventKit read backend. Maps is not included.

tools.name: contacts
tools.description: Search and retrieve contacts from Apple Contacts app

tools.name: notes
tools.description: Search, retrieve and create notes in Apple Notes app

tools.name: messages
tools.description: Interact with Apple Messages app - send, read, schedule messages and check unread messages

tools.name: mail
tools.description: Interact with Apple Mail app - read unread emails, search emails, and send emails

tools.name: reminders
tools.description: Search, create, and open reminders in Apple Reminders app

tools.name: calendar
tools.description: Search, create, and open calendar events in Apple Calendar app
